Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Are you an experienced Quality Engineering Engineer with a passion for test automation and driving quality excellence? Join our team based in Bucharest or Cluj to lead and expand automation capabilities within a dynamic, API-driven environment.
 What You’ll Do 
 - Enhance and maintain Python-based test automation frameworks
 - Automate regression packs and manual tests to increase coverage and reduce manual effort
 - Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, and QE teams
 - Drive risk-based testing, defect analytics, and quality gate integration
 - Coach squads on sustainable test automation practices and improve release confidence
 What We’re Looking For 
 - 5+ years in software testing and automation with hands-on Python experience
 - Strong skills in RESTful API testing, JSON, XML, and API authentication
 - Proficient with test management and CI/CD tools: TestRail, Jira, Git, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions
 - Experience with functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and risk-based testing
 - Experience in real-time, event-driven, or high-volume transaction systems, preferably within low-latency financial services
 - Good understanding of SQL and database validation is a plus
 - Agile mindset with coaching and stakeholder engagement skills
 Location & Working Style 
 - Bucharest or Cluj, Romania
 - Hybrid work model with on-site presence as required (monthly 1-2 time to office presence)
 - Embedded within agile squads using risk-based planning and automation-first approaches
 Why Join? 
 - Lead automation in a complex real-time API platform
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a supportive Testing Chapter environment
 - Drive quality improvements and innovation with a focus on continuous improvement
 Ready to take the lead in shaping test automation and quality practices? Apply now and help elevate release confidence with cutting-edge automation!
 About Us 
 Ascendion is a global AI-first software engineering company delivering innovative solutions across Cloud, Salesforce, Data, AI/ML, Automation, and Product Engineering. We help leading enterprises accelerate their digital transformation through technology, talent, and innovation.
 With Ascendion, You:
Work on challenging global projects with leading enterprise clients.
Gain exposure to Salesforce, AI, Cloud, Data, and Automation initiatives.
Benefit from long-term project opportunities and career growth.
Participate in our employee referral program.
